name: io.github.tech-bam/framegrove
title: Framegrove: App Store screenshot generator
description: Render App Store, Google Play and iPhone Duo screenshots and Apple Creative Assets from templates.

environmentVariables.name: FRAMEGROVE_FONTS
environmentVariables.description: Optional folder for the template font cache (default ~/.cache/framegrove/fonts).

environmentVariables.name: FRAMEGROVE_OFFLINE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to skip the one-time font download.
